description: Make something in the signed-in member's Studio. EVERY KIND SPENDS FROM THEIR WALLET, charged only when the result is made and saved: say the price and get a yes before calling it, and make one thing per request. kind "image" ($0.05): one image from a description. Say what should be visible (subject, angle, lighting, background); no words, logos or real people's names. Optional shape. Ready in seconds; the result gives its id. kind "video_from_image" ($1.50): a 5-second video with no sound from one of their OWN Studio images. image_id is an id from an earlier image or from my_studio, never a link. movement describes what moves and how the camera moves, not the picture. kind "video_of_me" ($0.10 a second of video): a video of the member's own AI avatar saying a script in their own voice. Only for a member whose avatar and voice are READY (my_studio says); they are set up on the Studio page, not here. script is the exact words to say, up to 900 characters, written as they would say it out loud. Tell them the exact length and price from the result. Optional shape (default portrait). Both kinds of video only START here and take a few minutes: say it is being made and nothing is charged yet, and use my_studio in a minute or two to see when it is ready. One at a time. If the wallet is short, offer checkout_link.

description.description: For "image": what the image should show.

image_id.description: For "video_from_image": the id of one of their Studio images.

movement.description: For "video_from_image": what should move, in plain words.

script.description: For "video_of_me": the exact words they will say.

shape.description: The frame. Images default to square, videos of the member to portrait.

name: studio_make
title: Make an image or a video in the Studio
